newsitem.title: INDIA: India Essar Commvision says phone line plan alive.
newsitem.headline: India Essar Commvision says phone line plan alive.

text.p: India's Essar Commvision Ltd (ECL), in which Bell Atlantic Corp has 10 percent equity, will accept a fixed line telephone licence for the state of Punjab by August 31, a company spokesperson said on Monday.

The Essar group and Bell Atlantic formed ECL in 1995 to bid for rights to start a network in Punjab, but ran into problems with the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) over payment of bank guarantees for a licence. The DoT this year tried to remove it from a shortlist of companies considered for fixed line licences, and ECL countered by filing a suit against the DoT.

"The Department of Telecommunications has given us until August 31, as we have withdrawn a civil suit against them. We are putting our financing in place, and hope to sign the licence before August 31," an ECL spokesperson told Reuters.
She said that the company had to pay 1.31 billion rupees ($36.6 million) as the first year licence fee, and place bank guarantees of 750 million rupees by August 31.

The ECL spokesperson also denied reports in the Indian daily The Observer of Business and Politics that Bell Atlantic was quitting the joint venture. "They are our partner, and will stay in the consortium for at least five years."

She added that the Essar group had asked Bell Atlantic to increase its stake to 30 percent in ECL, but the American company had decided not to do so in the wake of the telecommunications deregulation in the US.
ECL has big plans for Punjab, one of India's most prosperous states. The company plans to invest $1 billion over the next three years to install 525,000 lines.
It recently signed a deal worth $5 million with Motorola Inc for a hybrid cable pilot project to deliver voice, video and data to 2,000 households in Punjab.
The deal has the potential to involve 200,000 homes eventually, an ECL official had said when announcing the agreement, with each line worth around $1,000.
